main_text.l: maior & grauior accedit causa, Autho-
ris ipsius suprema voluntas Testameto co-
nsignata, qua quicquid supererat operum
ipsius sub tuo nomine exire voluit, &
solennia haec dedicationis verba praefe-
ferre, Gvlielmo Scoto In Perpe-
tvvm Testimonivm Amicitiæ No-
stræ Dedico Consecroqve. Acci-
pe igitur hoc grati animi testimonium
qualecunq; Analysin Logicam in Epi-
stolam ad Hebraeos, simulq; breue tra-
ctatum de Iustificatione, quæ ideo pla-
cuit cum hac Analysi coiungere, quòd
& propter breuitatè seorsim excudi non
poterat, & ad quæstionem de Iustifica-
tione hominis coram Deo determinan-
da doctrina de Christi sacerdotio, quæ
in hac ad Hebraeos Epistola accuratis-
simè tractatur, singulare visum habeat,
cùm illa ipsa oblatio & sacrificiū quod
Sacerdos Christus Patri ad expiāda pec-
cata nostra in cruce obtulit, sit vnica
illa iustitia quā nobis Deus imputat, &
propter quam nos è tribunali suo iustos
esse pronunciat. Hanc autem Analysin

page.notes: Page is a column of running text; the last printed line ends mid-sentence ("Analysin") and continues on the next page. Some spelling is original (e.g. "Testameto", "quòd"). The empty foot paragraph above is a placeholder and should be ignored; no footnotes are printed. Hyphenated line-end words were joined: "Authoris" (from "Autho-ris"), "Epistolam", "Epi-ftolam", "accuratissimè" from "accuratif-fimè", "expiāda" retained as printed.
